entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man... This place totally does[n]feel like a Palace...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, I guess it'd be strange driving on[n]the tracks like this in the real world...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Anyway, Nakanohara's somewhere[n]in here, right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Most likely in a segment of his[n]own creation. Don't worry, it[n]won't be the size of a Palace.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Our next step is to find an entrance[n]to that segment.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: And what's this entrance[n]gonna look like?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I have no idea, but strong distortions[n]should be a pretty obvious visual clue.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So we just gotta go wanderin'[n]around for it then? What a[n]goddamn pain in the ass...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Why don't we leave[n]this room first?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So? What else do you wanna do?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There's something I'd like to check[n]in an area further down.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: First off, we should look for a platform[n]that'll let us descend.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait, you've been here before, right?[n]Don't you got like a map or something?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That would hold no meaning in[n]this place. The layout changes[n]every time you enter.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait, so our path changes too!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This place is the fused cognition[n]of a countless number of people.[n]It's constantly shifting.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Even so, our destination should be[n]pretty close. I'm counting on you, Joker.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There's something I'd like to check[n]in an area further down.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That platform we saw earlier should be[n]the way down. Let's head there first.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, there it is! The thing I want to[n]make sure of is inside!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Huh...? What's going on...?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Something's different in here...[n]I can't sense any targets.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: This has never happened,[n]not even in a Palace...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: This is perfect. We don't got time to be[n]dealin' with those weak dudes anyways!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes, the fewer hindrances we meet[n]on our descent, the better.
